metadata.description: Qwen3-8B-Base vs Qwen3-8B (thinking off) on two path-search tasks (T1 unweighted grid path, T2 weighted shortest path). Arms: base template-free, base chat-templated, instruct chat, instruct template-...

deviations.what: Models read from the run's shared HF cache (HF_HOME preset by the platform) instead of ./hf_cache
deviations.why: Platform rule: never override HF_HOME/TRANSFORMERS_CACHE (avoids duplicate weights); no workspace hf_cache exists

deviations.what: vLLM 0.11.0 run with enforce_eager=True, max_num_seqs=48 (plan: 16), generation_config='vllm'
deviations.why: Container has no C compiler for Triton/Inductor; max_num_seqs only changes throughput; generation_config='vllm' guarantees the HF sampling defaults (T=0.6, top_p=0.95, top_k=20) are never merged

deviations.what: Program extraction keeps only top-level imports/defs/classes/assignments for EVERY arm (plan: template-free arms only)
deviations.why: Identical rule across arms so module-level demo code (prints, example calls) can never crash an otherwise valid chat solution
